description: This file defines the PrintNode class in the Twig templating engine, representing a node that outputs an expression during template compilation.

classes.name: PrintNode
classes.description: A node class in Twig representing an expression that outputs its value during template rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the node with an expression and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the node into PHP code, outputting either a 'yield' or 'yield from' statement based on whether the expression is a generator.
